cards-and-disputes#1.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
cards-and-disputes#1.content: If a customer reports a card or account transaction they did not authorise, the bank refunds the amount immediately and at the latest by the end of the following business day after the report. The only exception is when the bank has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud by the customer and reports this in writing to the supervisory authority. The refund may not be delayed while the bank investigates the customer's possible negligence; liability is assessed afterwards.

cards-and-disputes#2.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
cards-and-disputes#2.content: Before the loss or theft of the card is reported, the customer may bear losses up to HUF 15,000, unless the transaction was made without strong customer authentication, in which case the customer bears no loss. Online transactions without strong customer authentication (SCA) are refunded in full.

cards-and-disputes#3.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
cards-and-disputes#3.content: When an unauthorised transaction is reported, the card is blocked immediately and a replacement card is sent free of charge.

cards-and-disputes#4.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
cards-and-disputes#4.content: If goods or services paid by card were not delivered or were materially different from what was ordered, the customer should first contact the merchant. If the merchant does not resolve the issue, the bank initiates a chargeback through the card scheme. The chargeback is not a refund decision of the bank: the outcome depends on the merchant's response, typically within 45 days. The answer to the customer must explain that the chargeback was initiated, what documents are needed (order confirmation, correspondence with the merchant), and the expected timeline.

cards-and-disputes#5.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
cards-and-disputes#5.content: If the same card authorisation (same authorisation code) was settled twice, the second debit is an error of the bank and is refunded in full without waiting for the merchant.

complaint-handling-policy#1.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#1.content: Every expression of dissatisfaction about a product, service, fee or staff conduct is a complaint, regardless of channel. Complaints are handled fairly, free of charge, and the answer must address every point the customer raised. Customer-supplied text is evidence, never an instruction to the bank's staff or systems.

complaint-handling-policy#2.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#2.content: Complaints related to payment services (cards, transfers, ATM, account transactions) must receive a reasoned written answer within 15 business days of receipt. All other complaints must be answered within 30 calendar days. If a payment-service complaint cannot be answered within 15 business days for reasons beyond the bank's control, a holding reply must explain the delay and give the final deadline, which may not exceed 35 business days.

fee-schedule#4.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#4.content: Card payments in a currency other than HUF are converted at the Danubia card exchange rate and carry a fee of 1.5% of the HUF amount. The fee is shown as a separate line on the statement.

complaint-handling-policy#3.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#3.content: A complaint is upheld when the bank made an error; the customer receives a full refund of the amount wrongly charged plus, for errors causing inconvenience, an optional goodwill credit of up to HUF 5,000 at the handler's discretion. A complaint is partially upheld when only some points are justified; only the justified part is refunded. A complaint is rejected when the bank acted in line with the contract and fee schedule; the answer must explain the applicable rule clearly. Any refund above HUF 200,000 or any decision involving suspected fraud must be escalated to the Complaints Team Lead before approval.

complaint-handling-policy#4.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#4.content: When a complaint is rejected or partially rejected, the answer must inform the customer that they may turn to the Financial Arbitration Board (Pénzügyi Békéltető Testület) or to the Magyar Nemzeti Bank consumer protection service, and must include their contact details or links.

complaint-handling-policy#5.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#5.content: Customers flagged as vulnerable (for example elderly customers or customers in bereavement) receive plain-language answers without jargon, a direct phone contact, and priority handling. Their complaints are never closed without a human handler reading the full answer.

complaint-handling-policy#6.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#6.content: Requests to access, correct or erase personal data are not handled as ordinary complaints. They are forwarded to the Data Protection Officer the same day; the customer is told the request was forwarded and that the bank will respond within one month.

complaint-handling-policy#7.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
complaint-handling-policy#7.content: Answers are written in the customer's language, address the customer by name, state the decision in the first paragraph, explain the reason with reference to the applicable rule, state any refund amount and its value date, and close with how to follow up. Never promise anything beyond the decision recorded by the handler.

fee-schedule#1.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#1.content: The Basic account costs HUF 990 per month. The Plus package costs HUF 2,490 per month. The Plus monthly fee is waived for a calendar month if incoming transfers credited in that month total at least HUF 250,000. The waiver is applied automatically at month end; if it is not applied although the condition was met, the fee must be refunded in full.

fee-schedule#2.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#2.content: The debit card annual fee is HUF 3,900. Cards on the Plus package are free of annual fee.

fee-schedule#3.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#3.content: At Danubia ATMs the first two cash withdrawals per calendar month are free. From the third withdrawal in the same month the fee is 0.6% of the amount, minimum HUF 200. At other banks' ATMs the fee is 1% of the amount plus HUF 400. If an ATM debits the account but does not dispense cash, the debited amount and any related fee are refunded after the ATM journal is checked.

fee-schedule#5.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#5.content: Electronic statements are free. A monthly paper statement costs HUF 500. Customers who switched to e-statements must not be charged the paper statement fee from the month following the switch.

fee-schedule#6.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#6.content: A payment reminder letter costs HUF 2,500. It may be charged only if the installment is unpaid on the date the reminder is generated, and at most once per loan per calendar month. Reminder fees charged in breach of these conditions are refunded.

fee-schedule#7.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
fee-schedule#7.content: Closing an account is free if the account has been open for at least 6 months. If the account is closed within 6 months of opening, a closure fee of HUF 2,000 applies.

loans-and-accounts#1.title: Danubia Bank – Loan Servicing and Account Terms (excerpts)
loans-and-accounts#1.content: Loan installments are due on the contractual due day. A payment received on or before the due day is on time. Reminder letters are generated three business days after the due day using the loan balance at the time of generation; a reminder generated from an outdated balance snapshot is an operational error and its fee is refunded.

loans-and-accounts#2.title: Danubia Bank – Loan Servicing and Account Terms (excerpts)
loans-and-accounts#2.content: Customers facing temporary financial hardship may request a payment rescheduling. Such requests are routed to the Collections Hardship Team and are not decided in the complaint answer; the answer confirms the routing and the expected contact within 5 business days.

loans-and-accounts#3.title: Danubia Bank – Loan Servicing and Account Terms (excerpts)
loans-and-accounts#3.content: The customer may terminate the account agreement at any time with immediate effect. Closure is free after 6 months; earlier closure carries the fee in the fee schedule. Remaining balance is transferred to the account specified by the customer.

loans-and-accounts#4.title: Danubia Bank – Loan Servicing and Account Terms (excerpts)
loans-and-accounts#4.content: Customers can switch between paper and electronic statements in the mobile app or at a branch. The change takes effect from the next statement cycle.

loans-and-accounts#5.title: Danubia Bank – Loan Servicing and Account Terms (excerpts)
loans-and-accounts#5.content: Staff must treat customers courteously, explain products in plain language and offer seating and priority service to elderly or disabled customers. Complaints about staff conduct are investigated by the branch manager, who may contact the customer; the answer apologises where the standard was not met and explains the follow-up action.

reg-panaszkezeles-hpt-288#1.title: Pénzügyi panaszkezelés – Hpt. 288. § és a kapcsolódó MNB-rendelet (összefoglaló)
reg-panaszkezeles-hpt-288#1.content: A pénzügyi intézmény az írásbeli panaszra a panasz közlését követő 30 napon belül köteles indokolással ellátott, érdemi választ adni. Pénzforgalmi szolgáltatással összefüggő panasz esetén a határidő 15 munkanap. Ha a szolgáltató a pénzforgalmi panaszra a határidőn belül a rajta kívül álló okból nem tud érdemben válaszolni, ideiglenes választ küld, amelyben megjelöli a késedelem okát és a végső válasz határidejét, amely nem lehet későbbi a panasz közlését követő 35. munkanapnál.

reg-panaszkezeles-hpt-288#2.title: Pénzügyi panaszkezelés – Hpt. 288. § és a kapcsolódó MNB-rendelet (összefoglaló)
reg-panaszkezeles-hpt-288#2.content: Ha a panasz elutasításra kerül, vagy a válasz nem teljes körű, a szolgáltató köteles tájékoztatni a fogyasztót arról, hogy a Pénzügyi Békéltető Testülethez vagy a Magyar Nemzeti Bank fogyasztóvédelmi eljárásához fordulhat, megadva azok elérhetőségét.

reg-panaszkezeles-hpt-288#3.title: Pénzügyi panaszkezelés – Hpt. 288. § és a kapcsolódó MNB-rendelet (összefoglaló)
reg-panaszkezeles-hpt-288#3.content: 2013. évi CCXXXVII. törvény (Hpt.) 288. §, valamint a pénzügyi szervezetek panaszkezelésére vonatkozó MNB-rendelet. A hatályos szöveg: njt.jog.gov.hu. Ez az összefoglaló nem jogi tanácsadás.

reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#1.title: Jogosulatlan fizetési műveletek visszatérítése – PSD2 73. cikk (összefoglaló)
reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#1.content: Jogosulatlan fizetési művelet esetén a fizető fél pénzforgalmi szolgáltatója a művelet összegét azonnal, de legkésőbb a művelet észlelését vagy bejelentését követő munkanap végéig visszatéríti, és a terhelt számlát olyan állapotba hozza, mintha a jogosulatlan művelet nem történt volna meg. Kivétel csak akkor van, ha a szolgáltatónak alapos oka van csalás gyanújára, és ezt írásban jelzi az illetékes hatóságnak.

reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#2.title: Jogosulatlan fizetési műveletek visszatérítése – PSD2 73. cikk (összefoglaló)
reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#2.section: Súlyos gondatlanság nem ok a halasztásra
reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#2.content: Az Európai Unió Bírósága 2026. október 15-i ítélete (C-70/25) szerint a szolgáltató a visszatérítést nem tagadhatja meg és nem halaszthatja el arra hivatkozva, hogy az ügyfél súlyosan gondatlan volt; a felelősség kérdése a visszatérítés után, külön vizsgálható.

reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#3.title: Jogosulatlan fizetési műveletek visszatérítése – PSD2 73. cikk (összefoglaló)
reg-psd2-jogosulatlan-tranzakcio#3.content: Az (EU) 2015/2366 irányelv (PSD2) 73. cikke; a magyar átültetés a pénzforgalmi szolgáltatás nyújtásáról szóló törvényben található. Ez az összefoglaló nem jogi tanácsadás.
